Sections: What are Headings?; Checking Headings / Checking other pages; What to look for

Change notice: selected excerpts; whitespace normalized. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt and licenses/.
Click on the ‘Check headings’ link in your bookmarks
They should be nested by their rank or level.
Headings should be succinct and describe the section or text of the page that follows.
Are any heading levels skipped? Are any headings levels blank with no text? Does any text look like a heading but not showing up as one?
Does the heading text reflect the content that follows? Do the headings represent the structure of the content, particularly nested content?
Did the the list start with an H1?
